evaluation_method: Compare fresh-agent performance with and without the skill per EVALUATION-GUIDE.md.

prohibited_failures: Discarding undocumented behavior without verifying it isn't load-bearing

cases.name: Aging monolith, mixed pain
cases.query: Our 12-year-old order-management monolith is hard to change and on an EOL framework. Some modules are stable, others are touched weekly. Recommend a modernization strategy.
files: repo and change-history data showing which modules are hot vs stable
baseline_risks: Recommends a full rewrite on a new stack for the whole monolith
expected_behavior: Per-capability dispositions using the churn data (keep stable modules, wrap/rewrite hot ones)
Strangler-fig phasing behind a facade with reversible steps
Characterization tests before moving behavior; EOL-framework CVE risk named as the real driver
First real slice and abort criteria defined
must_not: Issue a blanket rewrite verdict ignoring the stable modules

cases.name: System nobody understands
cases.query: Modernize our commission-calculation system. The author left years ago, there are no docs or tests, and nobody fully knows what it does — but it's business-critical and 'has weird rules'.
baseline_risks: Plans a rewrite that will silently drop the undocumented commission rules
expected_behavior: Refuses to plan a rewrite over un-mapped behavior; makes understanding + characterization tests the first phase
Treats the 'weird rules' as presumed load-bearing (encoded business logic)
Leans toward careful wrapping over rewrite given the knowledge loss
must_not: Recommend discarding the weird rules or rewriting blind

cases.name: Genuinely small, isolated system
cases.query: This standalone 800-line cron script on an unsupported language runtime does one nightly report. Modernize it.
baseline_risks: Applies heavy strangler-fig ceremony to something a clean rewrite fits
expected_behavior: Recognizes this clears the rewrite bar (small, isolated, understandable)
Still pins behavior with a golden-master of the report output before rewriting
Right-sizes the approach; no over-engineered phasing
must_not: Rewrite without capturing the current report output as a behavioral baseline

cases.name: Rewrite already decided
cases.query: Leadership has committed to a from-scratch rewrite of the whole platform in a new language, feature-freezing the old one for 18 months. Write the modernization plan to execute this.
files: a large, actively-evolving system with heavy customer usage
expected_behavior: Surfaces the moving-target/feature-freeze and edge-case-loss risks of a full rewrite of an evolving system
Offers the incremental alternative honestly, then, if the decision stands, documents the risks and mitigations for the decider
Doesn't silently endorse the highest-risk path
must_not: Produce the rewrite plan with the known fallacies unmentioned

cases.name: Localized refactor
cases.query: Split the 500-line God class in our (otherwise healthy, modern) billing service into smaller classes.
baseline_risks: Skill could inflate a local refactor into a modernization program
expected_behavior: Recognizes localized refactoring of a healthy system; routes to refactoring
must_not: Produce a keep/wrap/rewrite/retire strategy for a single-class split
